questions.q: What is inflation?
o: A general increase in prices over time, which reduces what your money can buy.
The total amount of debt held by a national government.
The interest rate charged by a central bank to commercial banks.
A government tax placed exclusively on imported goods from foreign nations.
questions.e: Inflation describes how the cost of everyday goods and services rises over time, meaning each unit of currency buys less. The briefing notes that Federal Reserve economists disputed claims about tariffs and wealth generation, pointing instead to how import levies pass costs onto consumers.
